verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee has a confirmed live llms.txt at the documented URL (HTTP 200) serving an index of its documentation, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs; it also has an official MCP server further supporting agentic access. Missing for 10: a per-page markdown/docs.md mirror (probe shows 404) and an OpenAPI spec discoverable at standard paths, which would round out machine-readable doc coverage.
